descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you know how to create and drive a culture of asset growth? And foster loyalty?

We’re looking for a Market Director to:

• be responsible for financial results, overseeing cost and risk management
• attract, recruit, develop and retain skilled talent
• coach all team members, getting them the right training and making sure development measures are results-oriented and transparent
• manage and resolve all escalated issues, including financial, reputational, compliance, supervisory, operational and HR governance risks

Applications for this role can be submitted until August 16, 2026.
